correctness.rationale: The ordered Singleton bound gives at most q^(4-3+1)=q^2. The two rightmost block coordinates (b,d) must distinguish codewords: if both agree, weight <=2. For equality they cover Q^2 bijectively. Holding b=u fixed and changing d=v makes the second block weight 2 and requires the first-coordinate map v->F(u,v) to be injective, hence a permutation. Holding d=v fixed symmetrically forces u->G(u,v) to permute. Both conditions suffice for distance>=3; there are 2q independent q-permutations, giving (q!)^(2q). At q=2 each permutation is affine, so F=v+alpha*u+beta and G=u+gamma*v+delta, and translations/shears act transitively. Independently exhausted all binary four-subsets of 16 words, finding exactly 16 maxima, and enumerated all 6^6=46656 q=3 permutation-function choices, verifying distinct codebooks and pairwise minimum distance >=3.
